name: Partial MaxSAT on the 2026 inconsistency-measurement instance
definition: Given a fixed weighted CNF formula with hard and soft clauses, assign every Boolean variable so that all hard clauses are satisfied and the total weight of satisfied soft clauses is maximized.
solution_format: An object with assignment, a list of 1630 Boolean values. Position i gives the value of variable i+1.
constraints: Every variable is assigned exactly once.
All 6150 hard clauses must be satisfied.
The objective is the sum of weights of satisfied soft clauses.
The 649 soft clauses each have weight 1, so the maximum possible objective is 649.
verification: Exact integer-literal evaluation of all hard clauses and all soft clauses; no declared score is used.

source_review.definition: 通用partial MaxSAT的原生inconsistency-measurement竞赛输入；全部硬子句必须成立，最大化软满足权。649减未满足权只是同一目标换算，不另计任务。
source_review.primary_sources: Sol亲自读取Zenodo21358014 v1官方metadata、完整集合21283148的meta.db及原始WCNF。实例hash b4794d123e18a908924d3d33cdeeae3b，原始输入SHA256 cd81f483b6cc3d05e9760274eee7697d9cc0f0a5a7146d3c6887af687d149195。1630变量、6150硬、649软、总软权649。
source_review.record_recovery: Sol通过HTTP范围读取官方logs.zip中央目录和BouMS ANYTIME-UW/60对应成员，独立核对ZIP CRC32，未下载完整1.8GB。原始.o日志完整v位串长度1630，.c报告62 VERIFIED；保存assignment SHA256 c129d0fded17b46dca93fe9a4c3c2273926c346c78578bfec2e922023a746543。
source_review.independent_math: 首先逐子句独立检查全部硬约束及softcost62/score587；正式验收另用任意精度整数的正负文字bitmask与assignment位集判断满足，独立于正式逐literal布尔求值。五种构造均核对。
source_review.human_baseline: DPLL1962公开传统方法和SymPy1.14实现重建硬SAT，再作保持硬可行的一位爬坡，H360。这是明确较弱的人类方法复现，不假称竞赛发表360或最强人类结果。官方BouMS587的AI协助来源未披露，单独保留unknown。
source_review.open_status: 2026官方metadata optimal_cost=unknown、best_known_cost=62，结果记录未给本参数最优性证明。未把SATISFIABLE或VERIFIED误当OPTIMUM。
